{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either column
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Print the number of rows after dropping missing values
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing values: {len(penguins_clean)}")

# Compute and print the Pearson correlation coefficient
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation coefficient: {correlation}")

# Return the correlation value for submission
correlation"}
